issues: credit-evolution-card is only on 'Informação' tab; users may miss trimestral evolution on default 'Documentos' tab. Consider surfacing a compact sparkline above the tabs (or on Documentos header) for immediate visibility.
Hydration warnings persist: <span data-ve-dynamic> rendered directly inside <tbody>/<tr>. Coming from visual-edit runtime, cosmetic only, but pollutes console (already reported in iteration 23).

action_items: (Optional) Consider moving/duplicating credit-evolution-card outside the Informação tab so it is visible without a tab switch.
(Carry-over cosmetic) Fix hydration warnings from <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <tbody>/<tr>.
critical_code_review_comments: process_open_documents_import wipes finance_open_documents globally on every run (delete_many({})). Safe by design but strong side-effect: if the parsed file is subtly wrong, all real docs disappear until next successful import. Consider staged replace: insert new -> swap -> drop old in a transaction/session, or at least keep a shadow snapshot for one cycle.

verify_promises_after_import only iterates promises with promise_date<as_of and status=='open'; that's correct, but there is no lock — a concurrent PUT /promises/{id} while auto-verification runs could race. Low probability in current usage.

Credit-warning route depends on 9-digit tail matching only. Ports/international numbers with <9 digits (older PT landlines beginning by 2 area codes with 8 digits) fail silently by returning show_warning=false. Consider matching on 8 as well and normalise leading zeros.
get_finance_settings merges only known DEFAULT_SETTINGS keys — good defensive posture; but there is no schema validation for numeric ranges on PUT (e.g. negative residual_max_documents accepted).
FinanceSettings PUT accepts payload without validating pct threshold range (0..1).
